proposal.summary: Pydio Cells (<= 4.1.2) contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) via the 'remote-download' job API which causes the server to perform HTTP GET requests to attacker-controlled URLs and save responses to user-specified targets.
proposal.cwe_quote: "When the job is started, HTTP GET requests are sent from the Pydio Cells server to the specified URLs. The responses are saved into a file, which are uploaded to the specified folder within Pydio Cells."

PR.quote: "Log into Pydio Cells and retrieve the JWT from the HTTP requests."

C.quote: "The responses are saved into a file, which are uploaded to the specified folder within Pydio Cells."

I.quote: "The responses are saved into a file, which are uploaded to the specified folder within Pydio Cells."

A.quote: "When the job is started, HTTP GET requests are sent from the Pydio Cells server to the specified URLs. The responses are saved into a file, which are uploaded to the specified folder within Pydio Cells."

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify whether authentication is required to invoke the /a/jobs/user/remote-download API on your deployment; if vulnerable, upgrade to a fixed version (>= 4.1.3 / 4.2.0 / 3.0.12) or block outbound HTTP from the server to untrusted network destinations.
